title: Coverage gate >= 85%
prompt:
Add [tool.coverage.run] (source = packages) and [tool.coverage.report] fail_under = 85 to pyproject. Wire `pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing` into CI so it fails under 85%.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: Made the >=85% coverage gate config-driven (PRD §6.2). Added [tool.coverage.run] with source = the five package namespace src roots (packages/{core,log,api,cli,ui}/src) + branch = true, and set [tool.coverage.report].fail_under = 85 (was the task-0.9 placeholder 0) with show_missing = true. pytest --cov now reads the threshold from pyproject, so there is a single source of truth and no hard-coded number. Wired ci.yml to be config-driven: the coverage step changed from `uv run pytest --cov --cov-fail-under=85` to `uv run pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing` (the --cov-fail-under flag is dropped because pyproject fail_under now enforces 85, avoiding a CLI value diverging from config per issue #9). TDD: wrote tests/test_coverage_config.py FIRST (asserts [tool.coverage.report].fail_under == 85 and [tool.coverage.run].source covers all five packages/*/src roots) — watched 2 fail (red: fail_under was 0, no [run] table), then added the config (green). Reconciled the existing CI contract test: updated tests/test_ci_workflow.py's ORDERED_GATE_FRAGMENTS, replacing the now-removed '--cov-fail-under=85' fragment with 'pytest --cov' (still present, still in order) so the CI test stays green with the config-driven command. Proved the gate bites: temporarily set fail_under = 101 and ran uv run pytest --cov — coverage raised ConfigError rejecting it, confirming pyproject's fail_under (not a CLI flag) is the active source; reverted to 85. Gates: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . = 19 files already formatted; mypy = no issues in 19 source files; uv run pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing = 48 passed, coverage scoped to the 5 packages (term-missing Missing column shown), 100% coverage, 'Required test coverage of 85.0% reached'. SKIPPED line-limit check (task 0.10, scripts/check_line_limit.py not built yet) per task note — all touched files are well under 150 lines anyway. No external API / LOG / runtime-config surface relevant to this config-only task.
